sources.games: 602 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 48.2%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py ogre_magi.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 84 (abilities named in fight and skills), 7.41f.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-11-07 (support wave): the build follows the STRATZ high-rank order where it and the league games disagree; Eul's Scepter answers Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness (Jakiro, Rubick, Skywrath Mage, Tusk); Rod of Atos against escapes (a root stops walking and blink escapes); Ghost Scepter against two physical carries stays on thin samples; the skill builds and talents are the most common ones.

rules.name: Ghost Scepter
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Ghost Scepter: Ghost Form for 4 s, immune to physical damage, unable to attack, 30% more magic damage taken, 22 s cooldown. High-rank games against 2+ physical carries: 18% of 33 games (8% otherwise), won 83% with it against 52% without (6 games with it).

reason.en: {enemy} and another physical carry are in their team: {item} makes you immune to physical damage for 4 s, though you cannot attack
reason.uk: {enemy} та ще один фізичний керрі в їхній команді: {item} робить вас невразливим до фізичної шкоди на 4 с, але атакувати в цей час не можна

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute (parts and consumables dropped): arcane_boots 94% (11), hand_of_midas 31% (21), glimmer_cape 34% (23), aether_lens 34% (23), solar_crest 27% (25), aghanims_shard 33% (26). STRATZ pos4 and pos5 (2814 and 4968 games): Hand of Midas at 17-18 min is the only core row (100%).
